propositions: CLI --timeout and --timeout-method flags on _build-and-test.yml shared-tier lanes (default-suite and integration) permanently shadow ini config changes in patchsets due to trusted-main workflow execution precedence and pytest-timeout precedence order (CLI > env > ini)

A patchset that modifies the shared-tier hang budget in pyproject.toml cannot be tested by its own Verified run because the CI workflow file (from trusted main) carries hardcoded CLI flags that override the ini values

The conftest-floor mechanism to enforce a timeout floor is unsupported: pytest-timeout resolves config._env_timeout at session start read-only with no hook point for runtime floor enforcement and no OSS precedent

Removal of the --timeout=300 --timeout-method=thread CLI flags from both shared-tier lanes and reliance on ini config [tool.pytest.ini_options] achieves single-sourcing with no effective budget change (ini already carries identical values)

The eleven other CI pytest lanes (external-integration, optionality, eval-discipline, test.yml, structured-output-baseline) retain their explicit calibrated CLI timeout flags because they drive live services and may run outside repo rootdir where ini is unavailable
